nodes.description: uint256 private seed: VRF randomness stored after fulfillRandomness, used as input for all in-game randomness
mapping(bytes32 => TokenData) tokenDataEncoded: level, owner, faction, elite and stake metadata per token
EnumerableSet.Bytes32Set redElites: set of staked elite tokens of the red faction
EnumerableSet.Bytes32Set blueElites: set of staked elite tokens of the blue faction
uint256 houseUpgradeCost: BLD price of a single tree-house level upgrade
uint256 treeHouseRisk: base risk percentage for tree-house collections
uint256 tokenGeneratorRisk: base risk percentage for token-generator collections
uint256 HOUSE_CAP = 5: maximum tree-house level
uint256 LEVEL_CAP = 1000: maximum token level
uint256 BASE_RISK = 50: base risk used for bear collections
uint256 HOME_STAKE = 1: stake type identifier for home staking
uint256 TREE_HOUSE_STAKE = 2: stake type identifier for tree-house staking
mapping(string => address) contractsAddressesMap: registry of external contract addresses (token, gen0, gen1, treeHouse, tokenGenerator)
uint256[] levelMilestones: level thresholds used to look up level impacts
mapping(uint256 => ImpactType) levelImpacts: boost and riskReduction per level milestone
mapping(uint256 => ImpactType) stakeTypeImpacts: boost and riskReduction per stake type
uint256 private vrfFee: LINK amount paid for a VRF request
bytes32 private vrfKeyHash: key hash of the VRF oracle key
mapping(address => bool) authorisedAddresses: whitelist checked by the authorised modifier
address private _owner (Ownable): contract owner address
mapping(bytes32 => uint256) private nonces (VRFConsumerBase): per keyHash VRF nonce
LinkTokenInterface internal immutable LINK: LINK token used to pay for VRF randomness
address private immutable vrfCoordinator: only caller allowed to deliver VRF randomness
constructor(address,address,bytes32,uint256): initialises VRF params and via VRFConsumerBase/Ownable
setCollectionsKeys(string[],address[]) onlyOwner: registers collection addresses
setLevelImpacts(uint256[],ImpactType[]) onlyOwner: sets level milestones and impacts
setStakeTypeImpacts(uint256[],ImpactType[]) onlyOwner: sets stake-type impacts
setAuthorised(address[],bool[]) onlyOwner: manages the authorised contract whitelist
setHouseUpgradeCost(uint256) onlyOwner: updates house upgrade price
setTokensData(address,uint256[],uint256[],bool[],bool[]) authorised: seeds token level/faction/elite data
setStakedTokenData(address,address,uint256,uint256[]) authorised: marks tokens staked, updates elite sets and levelEnrolDate
unsetStakedTokenData(address,uint256[]) authorised: unstakes tokens, claims pending level and resets stakeType
getTokenKey(address,uint256) pure: keccak256 key for token metadata
getLevel(address,uint256) view: returns stored level of a token
getLevels(address,uint256[]) view: batch level getter
getLevelBoosts(address,uint256[]) view: batch level boost lookup over milestones
getLevelBoost(address,uint256) view: single level boost lookup
claimLevel(TokenSelection[]) public: user-facing level claiming, requires msg.sender to own every token
_claimLevelForToken(address,uint256) internal: computes stake level yield from elapsed time and boosts
isClaimSuccessful(address,uint256,uint256,uint256) external: risk-based game resolution, may transfer stolen BLD to an elite winner
_didLoseClaimAmount(uint256,uint256,uint256) view: weakness-prone hash-based loss determination
pickWinnerFromElites(bool,uint256) view: picks a random elite owner for the winning faction
_pickWinnerFromElitesBySide(Bytes32Set,uint256) internal view: random index into the elite set
_getRandom(uint256,uint256) internal view: pseudo-random number from seed, tx.origin, blockhash and timestamp
_getFaction(uint256) internal view: derives faction from the same weak hash construction
initSeedGeneration() onlyOwner: requests new VRF randomness paying the LINK fee
fulfillRandomness(bytes32,uint256) internal override: stores the VRF output into seed
upgradeHouseSize(uint256,uint256) external: spends BLD via IToken and increases house level
addLevel(address,uint256,uint256) authorised: increases a token level
setLevel(address,uint256,uint256) authorised: overwrites a token level
setEliteStatus(address,uint256) authorised: marks an unstaked token as elite
setHousesLevels(uint256[],uint256[]) authorised: batch sets tree-house levels
calculateLevels(address,uint256[]) view: batch expected level calculation
calculateLevel(address,uint256) public view: computes projected level from elapsed time and stake boost
setTokenGeneratorRisk(uint256) onlyOwner: updates token generator risk
setTreeHouseRisk(uint256) onlyOwner: updates tree house risk
requestRandomness(bytes32,uint256) internal (VRFConsumerBase): sends LINK.transferAndCall and bumps the nonce
rawFulfillRandomness(bytes32,uint256) external (VRFConsumerBase): restricted entry point that forwards to fulfillRandomness
_setOwner(address) private (Ownable): writes _owner storage and emits OwnershipTransferred
onlyOwner modifier: require(owner() == _msgSender())
authorised modifier: require(authorisedAddresses[msg.sender])
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used in access control and ownership checks
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable time source used for level yield and randomness
tx.origin: origin address mixed into the pseudo-random hash construction
external call IToken(contractsAddressesMap['token']).add(winner, amount_): transfers stolen BLD to a pseudo-random elite winner
external call IToken(contractsAddressesMap['token']).spend(msg.sender, houseUpgradeCost * upgrade_): spends user BLD before the house level is updated
external call LINK.transferAndCall(vrfCoordinator, _fee, data): pays and calls the VRF coordinator with arbitrary calldata
blockhash(block.number - 1) used inside keccak256 for 'randomness': predictable/miner-influenceable
levelYield = (block.timestamp - levelEnrolDate) / (stakeTypeImpacts[stakeType].boost * 1 days): division by attacker-influenced stake type boost
risk -= levelImpacts[...].riskReduction; risk = risk / stakeTypeImpacts[stakeType_].riskReduction / 100; risk<10?10:risk: division chain that can revert or distort risk
tokenDataEncoded[treeHouseKey].level += upgrade_: state update performed after the external token spend call
nonces[_keyHash] = nonces[_keyHash] + 1: nonce increment applied after the external LINK.transferAndCall
external/internal callback invocation of fulfillRandomness(requestId, randomness) from rawFulfillRandomness
seed = randomness: overwrites the global randomness seed from the VRF callback, affecting all future game outcomes
tokenDataEncoded[key].level += levelIncrease_: authorised caller can arbitrarily raise a token level
houseUpgradeCost * upgrade_: multiplication used both in the balance check and the spend amount
require(owner() == _msgSender(), 'Ownable: caller is not the owner'): access control enforcement
require(authorisedAddresses[msg.sender], 'The token contract is not authorised'): access control enforcement
require(tokenDataEncoded[tokenKey].owner == msg.sender): ownership check before claiming level

bytes32 tokenKey: keccak key derived by getTokenKey, used as tokenDataEncoded lookup key
TokenData storage tokenData: storage pointer into tokenDataEncoded
uint256 levelYield: computed level gain from elapsed time and stake boost
uint256 risk: loss probability derived from BASE_RISK, level reductions and stake type
bool isBearCollection: whether the collection is gen0/gen1
bool didLose: outcome of the risk roll, may be reset if no elite winner exists
bool winningFaction: faction that must supply the winner when the player loses
address winner: elite owner receiving the stolen BLD amount
uint256 vRFSeed: seed produced by makeVRFInputSeed for the request id
uint256 index: random index into the elite set
